# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to making participation in this project a respectful, welcoming, and harassment-free experience for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive in discussions and reviews.
- Assume positive intent and ask clarifying questions.
- Give feedback on code, not on people.
- Accept feedback gracefully and collaborate on solutions.
- Help keep discussions focused, inclusive, and professional.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Insults, trolling, or sustained disruptive behavior.
- Sexualized language or imagery.
- Doxxing, sharing private information, or threatening language.
- Any behavior that creates an unsafe environment.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to project spaces, including issues, pull requests, discussions, code reviews, and other project communication channels.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, contact project maintainers privately.

When reporting, include:

- What happened
- Where it happened
- Who was involved
- Any relevant screenshots or links

All reports will be reviewed promptly and handled as confidentially as possible.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may take any action they consider appropriate, including warning, temporary restrictions, or removal from project participation, depending on the severity and pattern of behavior.

## Good-Faith Participation

We value contributors who engage in good faith, communicate clearly, and support a healthy collaboration environment.
